title: Mixed Event — As the Leaves Change Once More

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More
meta.Outline: After the success at Jam Fest, Shiho is energized to practice. But Shizuku and Saki invite her on a day trip to relax and enjoy the fall foliage.

rows.Line: Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Okay, that felt pretty good just now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My fingers are moving well, and I'm maintaining a steady rhythm.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ever since Jam Fest ended, I've been in good form.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That was really fun...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (More people than we were expecting ended up listening to our song.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I was thinking about calling it a day, but I wanna keep practicing for a bit longer.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I just finished the second verse, so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Shii, can I come in?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The bath is ready, so I came to see if you wanted to go first.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, it's already that late?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I want to keep practicing, so I'll take mine later.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
Then, I think I'll take mine now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, Shii...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've been practicing late into the night for quite a while now. Please don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? Yeah, I'll be careful.
Thanks, Shizuku.
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I think I stayed up too late again last night. I still feel kinda sleepy...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should end practice early today and...)

Oh, Shiho, there you are!
Hey, I found her!
You did? Thank you for finding her so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki? Shizuku...?
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's something we'd like to discuss with you. That's why we were looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Discuss with me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've got a bad feeling about this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
We've actually got some wonderful news that's sure to excite you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, fine... So, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ahem.
Well, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How would you feel about us taking a day trip together?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A day trip...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we'll travel somewhere a bit out of the way to have delicious food and see beautiful sights! Doesn't that sound wonderful?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wonderful or no...
Why a day trip all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. The thing is, while walking to school earlier...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's been getting much cooler lately.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The leaves are changing color, there's a nice aroma of osmanthus in the air... A lovely autumn day in every respect.)
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shizuku! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Good morning, Saki.
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem to have brought a bit of fall with you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
There's a red leaf stuck to your hair.
Just give me a second to get it out...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright, all done.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe it flew over on that breeze just now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Also, this leaf's so pretty!
It really feels like, you know, it's fall!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Very much so.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be wonderful to enjoy the season by going to see the leaves somewhere...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, now that you mention it...
Our family tried to go one time when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh?
Tried to go...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We didn't end up going, because it rained that day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa and I frowned out the window all day long.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Something similar actually happened to us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In our case, it began to rain right when we got to the foot of the mountain. Shii and I felt so sad. I vividly remember us holding hands while staring at the rainy mountain.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Is that true?
Hehe. What a coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Since we're on the subject...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, we still have to invite Tsukasa, but the Tenmas and Hinomoris are gonna go leaf-viewing together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We call it... The “Leaf-Viewing Reattempt”!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, what? Reattempt...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because all of us have experienced not getting to see the leaves! So, we're taking another crack at it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I was surprised to hear that both our families experienced something extremely similar. I get why you'd want to go...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But do any of us have time to take a trip right now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Urgh... But Jam Fest is over, so we have a little time on our hands...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I believe it's important to take breaks from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Please, Shiho!
I know it'll be fun if all four of us go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I would love to go on a trip with you, too. It's been so long, Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Saki
rows.Line:
Please, Shii!
Please, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh geez...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (To be fair, ever since Shizuku became an idol, we haven't really been able to go on trips as a family...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Plus...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I also felt really sad about not being able to see the leaves back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes!
All systems are go for the Tenma-Hinomori Leaf-Viewing Reattempt!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're making it even longer?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. What a cool name.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, but you two will need to come up with the itinerary and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we'll take care of all that, while making sure we don't interfere with your practice schedule.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna tell Tsukasa about this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait for our trip!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm glad I got off work early today.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Now I can go home and listen to the new CD I just bought.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Then I'll practice until it's time for dinner, and...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Doesn't Saki work over at that cafe?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I'm seeing some familiar faces in the window...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are those three doing there together?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (From what I can see, they're not studying together or anything. They have a bunch of books and magazines laid out on their table...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't know what's going on, but if they see me, it's going to be a whole thing. I'll just pass by quickly...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They saw me.)
carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, what are you guys doing with all these books and magazines?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I'm glad you asked!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were just in the middle of planning the Tenma-Hinomori Leaf-Viewing Reattempt!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Reattempt? Oh, you mean our day trip.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Saki said she could join in after her shift ended and asked us to meet here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, the three of us have decided to plan our trip together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, what do you guys have in mind at the moment?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're still brainstorming, but here are our notes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “Leaf-viewing followed by river rafting, lunch and a foot bath. Visit the art museum, have tea at a trendy cafe, visit the local shrine, climb a mountain and go fruit picking.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Doesn't it all sound like so much fun?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but... It's not going to be possible to do all these things in one day. Each of these places are pretty far apart, too, so that's gonna be a lot of time spent in transit...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I had a feeling...
I was hoping that we could fit in a few extra activities with efficient enough routing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. We sorta couldn't help ourselves. We just kept finding all these great things to do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Just take this magazine, for instance.
It gives all these recommendations and goes into so much detail.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, Tsukasa, check this out!
The rope bridge on this map looks really fun! It apparently creaks and wobbles like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that!
And based on its height, it likely offers a spectacular view.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, let's add it to the list.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is bad. If I let these three handle everything, they won't have anything decided by the day of...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I have no choice.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you guys just keep adding to that list, then you're not gonna get anything done.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You won't be able to come up with a real plan if you keep cramming in more and more activities.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Urgh... Fair point...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You already have plenty on this list, so it's time to start narrowing down which are our most viable options.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why don't we begin by coming up with the goal for this trip?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The goal...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Our primary goal is to see the leaves, right?
So, we should begin by picking where we're going to do that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, we can start looking at other places to visit and activities to do. Wouldn't that help smooth out this process?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's excellent...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, then...
How about we go leaf-viewing on this mountain?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look! It even says that now's the best time to see them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and it's close enough that we can travel there and back by train.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, there's even a historical village nearby with old buildings and cafes, as well as a vineyard where we can pick our own grapes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Fall is all about bountiful harvests!
We must take this opportunity to go fruit picking, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A historical village and fruit picking...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We can visit both using a bus.
Why don't we add them to the list?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Our itinerary's coming together so fast!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for doing this, Shii. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's use this momentum to keep hammering out the details of our trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay! Does this itinerary look good to you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, let's just check over our route one last time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After arriving at the station, we'll explore the historical village. We'll take a quick break at this cafe and then go fruit picking.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Finally, we'll go leaf-viewing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow...!
We'll really get to do all the things we wanted in one day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm excited to the max about this trip right now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm looking forward to this trip as well! I know! Why don't we practice picking grapes at home?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, practice picking grapes...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you again, Shii.
Thanks to you, I think we're in for a very fun trip now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's fine. Honestly, I was worried about what would happen if I left you three to your own devices...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Despite them saying that they'd take care of all the planning, I ended up doing most of the work.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can live with that.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's not often that we get to take trips like this together, so I should try to enjoy myself when we go.)
The day of the trip - Early morning
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I've finished my daily run, and I have everything packed for our trip!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What else do I have left to do...?
Oh, I still haven't done my morning strength exercises!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was a close one! I'll need to do those to ensure that we have a wonderful day!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Starting with pushups!
Hmph! Hmph! Hnnnnnnng!!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Morning, Tsukasa.
You seem more excited than usual this morning.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Morning, Mom!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's because Saki and I are going on a trip for the first time in a very long while! I can't contain my excitement!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That reminds me. I made a special breakfast today as a way to boost my luck. Have some if you like, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you.
I hope you two enjoy your trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, look at the time...
I need to wake Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Inhale*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sakiiiiii!!!!!
It's moooorrrnnniiiinnnggg!!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Huh?! Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
You don't have to shout!
I'm already up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Oh, you're checking to see if you've packed properly! Did you make sure to include bug repellent?

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's in this bag...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
No, it's not...!
Wait, where'd it go?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You two are so excited.
Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Mhm... It's morning already...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Huh...? My alarm went off earlier than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, right... Today's...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Rin-Rin-Riiiin☆ It's morning!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa...! You scared me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wakey wakey, Shih!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Relax... I'm already awake.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What? But you're still snuggled up in your bed! You're gonna be late if you don't start getting ready soon!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll get up. There's no need to rush.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm so excited about visiting that cafe, picking fruits and seeing some pretty leaves!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Thanks again for agreeing to let me go with you today, Shih♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you looked like you really wanted to go the other day when I told you about this trip...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think Shizuku and Tsukasa won't notice as long as you don't pop out too often.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Right! I should be fine since I can just sneakily watch from your pocket or Sakki's☆>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line:
Shii, are you awake?
We're going to be late if you don't get up soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm already up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Morning, Shii.
I'm glad we were both able to wake up early like we planned.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You didn't have to worry about that. I had an alarm set for today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, Shizuku, you've got bed head...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Look, around your right ear. This bit of hair's sticking up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What? But I thought I got it all...
I-I'll go fix it now...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
She's so careless when it comes to these things.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <She might've been distracted because she's just that excited about today. That happens to me a lot!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you also seem like the type to forget about fixing your bed head before going somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What?! R-Really?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But you've also gotten so excited about something that you forgot about other stuff, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <O-Or ended up just spinning your wheels...?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nope.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Y-Yeah, I probably am barking up the wrong tree...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<But you are excited about this trip, right?
I mean, you kept checking the weather forecast yesterday.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Of course I kept checking the forecast.
Depending on the weather, we would've had to pack differently.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I am glad that it's supposed to be nice out today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
So let's have lots of fun on today's trip♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, within reason...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness we made it here on time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: On time? We're not supposed to meet for another thirty minutes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We didn't have to rush out of the house like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I know...
But what if Tsukasa and Saki also got here early out of sheer excitement?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't think...
Hey, Shiho! Shizuku!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good morning to the both of you!
Wonderful weather for a day trip, wouldn't you say?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're really here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning. I had a feeling that you two wouldn't be far behind us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We ended up getting everything ready way before when we originally planned on leaving!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were both so excited that we decided to come here early!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's perfectly understandable. I was also so excited that I kept walking between my room and the front entrance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You all sound like elementary schoolers who can't wait to go on a field trip...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm glad we're all here.
Let's have as much fun as we can today!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start making our way towards the station.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, can we stop by the vending machines first? I forgot to buy a drink...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our train isn't scheduled to depart for a little while, so you should have plenty of time. Just be careful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Then, I'll be right back!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, I might join you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Umm... Saki went that way, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, see you in...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, Shizuku, wait!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not good! She's sure to get lost!
We need to chase after her, Shiho...!
se_run_women_001_2
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A trip like this means...snacks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, everyone, let's break out...!
The potato chips♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I knew you'd bring some.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, because they're yummy.
And I love the texture!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I even have some mini-star ramen for you, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, you bought some just for me?
Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Shii, you've loved these ever since you were little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm also a longtime fan.
Particularly because it has “star” in its name! I remember a time when I had these every day!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd rather not be seen as that big a fanatic.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha♪ Anyway, I'll open these up!
se_event_foliage_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's all over the floor now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
H-Hurry, we need to clean this up!
Before we arrive at the next station!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I'm so sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, the next station's our stop.
Start packing, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Where... Where is it...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Has anyone seen my ticket?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, don't tell me you lost it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've checked all my pockets, bag and everywhere else! It's completely vanished! There's no way they're going to let me out of the station!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, why didn't you just use your smart card?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The answer to that is simple! A physical ticket adds to the sentimental value of this trip!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me... Didn't you put it in your wallet because you were worried that you'd lose it if you put it in one of your pockets?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O-Of coooooourse!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we're here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
The air here feels so fresh and clean.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And the village has such a wonderful atmosphere to it. I'm very much looking forward to exploring it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(We finally made it...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our trip's just begun, but I'm already exhausted.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, check it out!
They've got one of those stand-in boards! Let's take a group photo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, what a colorful cast of characters!
Alright, I'll be... This octopus at the top!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, I'll be the tanuki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's go, Shiho! Hurry!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This only has room for three people, so I'll be the photographer for this one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I wish we could all be in it together...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, why don't we switch once you've taken ours? I'll take over on the camera next, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, nice idea!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, we don't need to take that many...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Geez, these three really just do whatever they feel... They're the complete opposite of me. I have no way of predicting what they're gonna do next...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can't let my guard down.)
Converted cafe

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Thank you for visiting.

rows.Speaker: Cafe Customer
rows.Line: That was a really nice cafe!

rows.Speaker: Cafe Customer
rows.Line: Yeah, the tea and anmitsu were both really good!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Seems like we should be able to get inside soon...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can't wait to see what this cafe's like.
You found this one, right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, in one of the magazines.
This cafe was apparently renovated from an old Japanese-style house.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It even has a long porch that runs adjacent to the garden, which means we'll be able to have some tea while enjoying the greenery.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tea by a garden... That sounds exquisitely Japanese! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
You're our group of four, yes? Please follow me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, we get to go in.

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Here are your seats.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, interesting. We're supposed to sit by letting our feet hang outside over the edge...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And they really did take an old house and turn it into a cafe.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(It actually kinda feels like our house...
But I've been to a cafe that felt like this.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see... I think they're going to place our tea on these tables and trays, so why don't we all sit side by side and—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line: It's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line: It's really by the gardeeeeeen!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're both that moved...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I mean!
I've never been to a cafe where you let your feet hang over the edge while gazing at a garden!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Me neither...!
I was completely under the impression that there'd be tables and chairs! To think that we'd be sitting on the floor like this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We get to enjoy this lovely breeze while having tea... How fantastic is that?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad you two like it here so much.
Then, why don't we sit in pairs and place a table between us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's sunny, nice... And I'm having such a great time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wish we could do something like this at home.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it would be nice to relax as a family at home like this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Based on what this cafe has to offer...
What if we had tea on the veranda?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, great idea!
We should ask Mom and Dad about this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it would be nice to give them a chance to relax for a change!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They seem to be enjoying themselves quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, so I guess this place is a hit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Anyway, enough about them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Open wide, Shii. Say, “Ahh.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Not happening.
I don't need your help with my anmitsu.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you've hardly eaten any of yours.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's not true. And really, I'm feeling very full after watching you enjoy your treat.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There you go again...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's been so long since we spent time together like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You were so busy preparing for that festival.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But you know...
We could do something like this at our house...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we have a porch like this at home, so we could have tea there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we can't really see much beyond the walls around the garden.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think enjoying people-watching and gazing at the scenery is the best part of this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Is it really that big of a difference? I don't really get it, myself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
For example, that family over there.
They seem very close, don't they?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The little girl is tugging on her father's hand. She seems so eager to get to where they're going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
She's pulling so hard that it almost looks painful...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She's right. There are a lot of different people here.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Those people over there seem like a group of friends. They're having fun taking pictures together...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The person next to them is having yakitori alone. Is it from the stall over there...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Oh, three pieces in one bite...
That's starting to look really good.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Doesn't this look like a piece of art?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A piece of art?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. All these different people are here enjoying this village and making their own precious memories...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You can see all that just by sitting here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why this view feels like art to me, and I think it's really wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A view that looks like art, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I never would've thought of it that way.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (From my perspective, I just saw a bunch of people going about their daily business...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... It is a nice view.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Oh, Shih's smiling...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(She seems more relaxed than usual.
This is perfect☆)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (And having tea by a garden like this seems like so much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I should ask Len to see if we can do something like this in SEKAI☆)
Vineyard

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've all put on some bug repellent...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's go pick ourselves some grapes!!!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Within reason, we shall pick every type of grape which this vineyard has available and enjoy the rich flavors that they have to offer!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They both sound so excited.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, maybe a little too excited...
I mean, we're just here to pick some grapes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We could just get some from a supermarket and eat those.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho...
You just don't get it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, the point of picking our own grapes isn't just to eat them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It looks like we, the masters of picking grapes, have no choice but to show you the way!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Masters of picking grapes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right! There is much to be gained from the act of picking your own grapes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What he said!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What is this bit you're doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: First, we must ask the growers about the signs of good grapes! Then, we are to spot the best ones using our own eyes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Imagine finding “the one”, picking the bunch and discovering that it's amazingly good! I wouldn't be able to contain my joy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In other words, the best part of all this is getting to feel really happy while having some yummy grapes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see...! That does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, why do you two know so much about picking grapes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We actually got to do this as a family when we were little. I remember it being quite the learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how hard we tried that time?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We saw these grapes that looked really sweet and delicious, but they were up super high. Tsukasa and I managed to get them by having me sit on top of his shoulders!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I remember my legs wobbling quite a bit, but we got a hold of our tasty treasure in the end...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You wouldn't believe how incredible those grapes were! All the hard work we put in to get them made them taste just that much better!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, our original plan was to stuff our bags with as many grapes as we could! But after we got that bunch, we were totally satisfied...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: During the remaining time, we ended up just carrying it around like nothing else mattered.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's such a wonderful expression of how close you two are.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But does that really give you two the right to call yourselves “masters of picking grapes”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah! Details, details!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've taught you the essentials regarding this matter, so let's start picking ourselves some grapes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Alright... Which grapes should I pick?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The growers said how the ones with the most color are the best, since it's proof that they've received plenty of nutrients.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
These ones look good.
Let's see... I'm supposed to cut...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, are you picking those?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, since they're a nice color.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree!
Oh, the bunch next to it also looks ripe. I think I'll pick those.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I wonder if she'll be able to manage it.
I've never really thought of her as having much of a green thumb...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'm supposed to firmly hold the stem and... There...
se_event_foliage_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow, you made that look so easy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I think it's because I've been helping people on their farms and such for work. They've really taught me quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't know that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Anyway, I'm glad she has some grapes now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now, as for mine... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What's wrong, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm having trouble cutting through this stem...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you may want to try holding the bunch more like this. That should help you cut all the way through.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, now try cutting it again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, lemme try...
se_event_foliage_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I did it...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
These farming shears can be a little tricky to use.
I'm so glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had no idea... Thanks, Shizuku.
se_walk_men_003_1
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Saki and I have harvested a few bunches! How are you two doing?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We each have one now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, the grapes you two picked look so plump and delicious♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they do! Anyway, now that we all have some, why don't we see how they taste?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We just gotta rinse them in some water, pick a grape off and... Do you have yours, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Shizuku, Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line:
Let's eat.
Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I didn't realize how juicy grapes are when they're fresh off the vine...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mmmmm! Aren't these amazing, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, they are...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, what a spectacular scene!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our little sisters are enjoying grapes that they harvested together! I want to preserve this moment for eternity by hanging it up in a frame!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean...!
The way they're smiling as they have their grapes... I wish I could watch them forever.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, I know how to make that happen! If we keep picking grapes for them, then we'll get to keep watching them like this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, what are you saying...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's brilliant, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, that means we have to find them the sweetest, most delicious grapes this vineyard has to offer! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-There they go...
<Haha! You both have siblings with way too much energy, Shih, Sakki☆>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hiya! I've been watching from your pocket. Picking grapes together seems like so much fun!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin, nice timing!
I was just about to call for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Guess what? We've got enough grapes for everyone to have back in SEKAI! Check it out!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Whoa!
We really get to have these?!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, I don't know if we'll be able to take all of these over, but get ready to have a bunch...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know!
What if we used these to throw a grape party in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<That's an amazing idea☆
As a member of the fun and games committee, I promise to help make it a great party!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, we could work with Hona to make grape parfaits, grape cake and grape juice!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <And we can decorate a classroom with lots of grapes!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: With grapes...? I feel like that's going too far...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Haha!
That's just one idea♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A grape party...
Then, that means we need to keep harvesting more!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, more?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Well, duh!
If we're gonna have a party, then we're gonna need a lot more than this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, I'm not about to let Tsukasa and Shizuku hog all the glory!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's have a competition to see who can pick the most!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If it's a competition, then I definitely don't want to lose.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, Shih, does this mean you're game?!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no way I'm letting you win!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I know I'm gonna pick the most delicious grapes in this vineyard!
Mountain

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We've climbed quite far now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Based on this map, the best spot for viewing leaves should be just up ahead...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
There's the observation deck!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's reattempt time!
We've gotta take as many pictures as we can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's try getting closer!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's no need to rush. It's not like the leaves are going anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? I thought I felt a raindrop just now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I felt one as well. Is a raincloud passing over us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, but the forecast said it wouldn't rain!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nothing for it. We need to hurry and see the leaves before it really starts coming down...!
se_run_women_003_4

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, here it comes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What terrible timing...
Did you all bring umbrellas?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we both brought compact umbrellas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That includes you, Saki.
You'll catch a cold if you don't stay dry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
But we were so close... It was sunny, and the leaves were right there...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We failed our mission...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Right. Up here in the mountains, the weather can change in an instant...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The goal of this trip was to go leaf-viewing, so we probably should've done this first.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Then we would've been able to see the leaves like we wanted...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's my fault for not scheduling this activity first.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It may be raining now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But this is also really nice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't know if it's because the rain made them wet, but these leaves seem much more vibrant compared to when the sun was out just now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I remember feeling so sad when it rained like this when we were children, but I think I'm really enjoying leaf-viewing in this weather.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm inclined to agree with Shizuku here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just as the leaves appear one way when it's sunny, they'll look completely different when it's rainy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Tsukasa, there's a leaf stuck to your umbrella...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like it's a part of my umbrella's design now! This wouldn't have happened if it were still sunny.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it's really pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We must be very blessed, getting to experience so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really am nothing like these three.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm always worrying about not wasting time and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even for this trip, I obsessed over coming up with the most efficient itinerary...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I immediately thought it fell apart the second something unexpected happened.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(But they don't care about any of that.
Instead, they're...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The answer to that is simple! A physical ticket adds to the sentimental value of this trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I know I'm gonna pick the most delicious grapes in this vineyard!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Doesn't this look like a piece of art?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're able to fully enjoy what's right in front of them...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They cherish every second of every moment.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Sure, that leads to us taking a lot of detours and having to clean up extra messes...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But when I'm with them, I'm able to see the benefits of all the things that I refused to consider...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (At least, that's what I feel.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad we came here today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Especially since we got to see such a beautiful view.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank goodness!
I'm so glad to hear that you're having fun, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm also glad.
I was honestly a little worried, since you almost literally carried this entire trip on your back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I sure did, and don't you forget it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oof...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm only teasing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look, it's starting to clear up a little!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Sunbeams are beginning to poke through the clouds...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The leaves... They're sparkling so much...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, very...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The contrast between these leaves and the sunset... What a stunning view!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. On top of seeing the leaves when it rained, we got to see them as the sky cleared back up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is all thanks to the plan you made for us, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, we can't thank you enough!
This place has been an absolute feast for our eyes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Thanks for putting so much thought into this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, this is all just a big coincidence.
To be frank, things didn't actually go according to plan.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I am glad to see them all smiling like this...)
Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm...? Tsukasa...? Wanna have another grape...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More... More... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're talking in their sleep...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Even in their dreams, they're inseparable.
They both seem so happy right now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Mhm...
I'm stuffed, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can also take a nap if you want, Shizuku. I'll wake you guys when we get to the station.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm okay.
If anything, Shii, you're more than welcome to use my shoulder as a pillow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll pass.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Still, Shii...
Today's trip ended up being very fun, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it was fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I honestly wasn't all that enthusiastic about this at first... But I enjoyed things more than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki and I have been really busy since going pro, but I think this trip was just the break we needed.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting me, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Of course!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so glad to hear that you had fun today, Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I know.
Why don't we go on a trip together sometime? Just the two of us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure there are plenty more places you'd like to visit and things you would like to see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We could go to some hot springs, see cherry blossoms and even spend a day at the beach...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We could also go leaf-viewing and sample local delicacies like this again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, there's no way we're gonna be able to find the time to do all those things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: M-Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You two seem to be having a fun conversation... What were you talking about just now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. We didn't mean to wake you two.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we were just discussing our next trip.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! Next trip...?!
Take me with you! I wanna go!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How are you immediately awake?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we should all go on another trip together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay! Alright, what are we gonna see next?!
Cherry blossoms? The beach?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, we actually just mentioned those things.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Both are excellent choices.
We can add them to the list of places we weren't able to visit today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally♪
That means we gotta start coming up with a new itinerary!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Things are starting to snowball again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I guess I wouldn't mind going again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho's also on board!
Now I feel even more excited about our next trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
And we're gonna have lots of fun again when we go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm hoping that we'll get to create more wonderful memories together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this time, you guys actually have to come up with everything yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not a problem! We're going to come up with a trip that surpasses the leaf-viewing extravaganza we just experienced! Right, you two?!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Now you're starting to worry me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our next trip, huh...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll probably have to help them plan things again...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But if it means getting to spend time with them like this again, then, well, maybe that's not so bad.)
